    • CardTransaction

      public CardTransaction()
      Default constructor. Note that this does not initialize fields to their default values from the schema. If that is desired then one should use newBuilder().

    • CardTransaction

      public CardTransaction(String transactionId, String cardId, String customerId, Long transactionTimestamp, Double transactionAmount, String currency, String merchantId, String merchantName, String merchantCategory, MerchantLocation merchantLocation, TransactionType transactionType, DeviceInfo deviceInfo, Boolean isCardPresent, String previousTransactionId)
      All-args constructor.
      Parameters:
      transactionId - Unique identifier for the transaction
      cardId - Unique identifier for the card
      customerId - Unique identifier for the customer
      transactionTimestamp - Transaction timestamp in milliseconds since epoch
      transactionAmount - Transaction amount
      currency - Currency code (ISO 4217)
      merchantId - Unique identifier for the merchant
      merchantName - Name of the merchant
      merchantCategory - MCC (Merchant Category Code)
      merchantLocation - Merchant location information
      transactionType - Type of transaction
      deviceInfo - Device information for online transactions
      isCardPresent - Whether the card was physically present
      previousTransactionId - Reference to previous transaction if applicable
